name: ChartFormat
description: Provides access to the Office Art formatting for chart elements.
remarks: Using a property or method that does not apply to the type of object that the ChartFormat object is attached to will result in a run-time error.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Fill
properties.description: Returns a FillFormat object for the parent chart element that contains fill formatting properties for the chart element. Read-only.

properties.name: Glow
properties.description: Returns a GlowFormat object for a specified chart that contains glow formatting properties for the chart element. Read-only.

properties.name: Line
properties.description: Returns a LineFormat object that contains line formatting properties for the specified chart element. Read-only.

properties.name: PictureFormat
properties.description: Returns a PictureFormat object for a specified chart that contains pictures. Read-only.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Returns a ShadowFormat object that contains shadow formatting properties for the chart element. Read-only.

properties.name: SoftEdge
properties.description: Returns a SoftEdgeFormat object for a specified chart that contains soft edge formatting properties for the chart. Read-only.

properties.name: TextFrame2
properties.description: Returns a TextFrame2 object that contains text formatting for the specified chart element. Read-only.

properties.name: ThreeD
properties.description: Returns a ThreeDFormat object that contains 3D-effect formatting properties for the specified chart. Read-only.

properties.name: AutoShapeType
properties.description: Returns the type of the specified shape. Read-only MsoAutoShapeType.
